Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — VectorAI liked the low-latency outputs. We ran some forecasts internally and are looking at 3 different consumption profiles for the Hosted API:

- Pilot (1 mo): ~50M tokens
- Production (monthly): ~900M tokens/month
- Aggressive growth: 1.5B tokens/month with seasonal spikes

Our procurement team asked whether you can offer a deeper per-token discount if we commit to a 6-month minimum for the production tier (~900M/mo) and whether there are step-down rates at 1B and 1.5B. The rate card you shared looks good for smaller customers but we need a custom price to make the economics work for our roadmap.

Can you share a committed-tier proposal and confirm whether Redwood can approve a one-time credit or onboarding rebate? I’ve attached a rough usage projection.

Thanks,
Anya

VectorAI

Hi Anya — great to hear the demo resonated.

Short answer: we can build a committed-tier quote that improves per-token economics, but deep discounts outside our rate card require a pricing exception and an approval loop (Sales + Finance + CRO). To make progress quickly, here’s a pragmatic starting point based on the volumes you shared:

- 900M tokens/mo commit (6 months): baseline rate card discount tier -> 18% off list
- Custom committed tier proposal (requires approval): up to 30% off at $X/month commit (TBD), with a 60-day payment term and an initial onboarding credit applied to month 1
- Step-downs: an additional 3% discount when monthly usage crosses 1B and a further 2% at 1.5B (applies to subsequent months)

I’ve attached the Q1 rate card for reference. If you’re ok with the outline above, I’ll prepare a formal proposal and start the internal pricing-exception request. For speed, it helps if you can confirm: target commit $/month, preferred payment term (30/60/Net45), and whether you need a data residency/KMS addendum.

— Soojin

Sooj, Marissa — I reviewed the numbers and VectorAI looks like a solid strategic win. Guidance: we can approve up to a 30% blended discount off list for a 6-month committed consumption if the following are in place:

- Minimum committed spend: $1.2M over 6 months (i.e., $200k/month equivalent)
- Payment term: Net30 (Finance will not accept Net60 for exceptions of this size without credit review)
- Onboarding credit: capped at 1 month of estimated spend and applied as a one-time invoice credit
- Clause: 90-day usage true-up and clawback if actual average monthly usage < 70% of committed volume

If VectorAI insists on 35% or Net60, escalate to CRO for exception. We also need Legal to sign off on modified SOW language for the commit and clawback. Please get a written confirmation of their intended monthly commit and preferred payment cadence.

Deal id VE-2026-184 — flagging for pipeline priority.
